# SuperBull

> A restyled, feature-rich dashboard for BullMQ. Run it standalone by mounting a server adapter (Express, Fastify, Hono, Koa, h3, hapi, Elysia, Bun, NestJS) inside your own app, or hosted at superbull.com by running the outbound-only connector next to your workers (one outbound WebSocket, no inbound port), which adds workspaces, analytics, alerts, dashboards, and public status pages.

## Docs

- [Overview](https://superbull.com/docs): what SuperBull is and how the pieces fit
- [Getting started](https://superbull.com/docs/getting-started): standalone and hosted quick starts
- [Standalone](https://superbull.com/docs/standalone): mount the dashboard in your own app with a server adapter
- [Connector](https://superbull.com/docs/connector): the hosted agent, flags, env vars, and delivery semantics
- [Hosted app](https://superbull.com/docs/hub): the hosted app, workspaces, and connector dashboards
- [Alerts](https://superbull.com/docs/alerts): failure and queue-depth alert rules with email delivery
- [Status pages](https://superbull.com/docs/status-pages): public per-connector status pages
- [Dashboards](https://superbull.com/docs/dashboards): saved dashboards over ingested events
- [Analytics](https://superbull.com/docs/analytics): throughput, durations, and failure analytics
- [REST API](https://superbull.com/docs/api): the embedded dashboard's full HTTP route reference
- [MCP](https://superbull.com/docs/mcp): MCP tools and setup
- [Configuration](https://superbull.com/docs/configuration): createBoard options, per-queue options, env vars

## MCP

- Endpoint: https://superbull.com/api/mcp (streamable HTTP)
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer` token, set via the `SUPERBULL_API_TOKEN` env var on the deployment
- Tools: list_connectors, remove_connector, list_queues, get_queue, get_queue_stats, get_job, get_job_logs, add_job, retry_job, promote_job, remove_job, pause_queue, resume_queue, clean_queue (connectors are created in the web UI)

## Packages (npm)

- [@superbull/api](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/api): framework-agnostic core (createBoard, BullMQAdapter, route table)
- [@superbull/connector](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/connector): outbound WebSocket agent for the hosted app (`npx @superbull/connector`)
- [@superbull/express](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/express), [@superbull/fastify](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/fastify), [@superbull/hono](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/hono), [@superbull/koa](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/koa), [@superbull/h3](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/h3), [@superbull/hapi](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/hapi), [@superbull/elysia](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/elysia), [@superbull/bun](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/bun), [@superbull/nestjs](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/nestjs): server adapters
- [@superbull/react](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/react): the prebuilt dashboard UI served by the adapters
- [@superbull/protocol](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@superbull/protocol): the gateway/connector WebSocket frame contract
